preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 40.
The number of ingredients N must be between 1 and 10,000.
The maximum amount of each ingredient K must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N space-separated integers representing the amounts of ingredients.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= g[i] <= K for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each ingredient amount g[i] must be between 1 and K.
The output must be a single line of space-separated integers representing the chosen amounts of ingredients.
